correctness.rationale: Re-audited repairs/3/RESULT.md. Frozen RESULT.md line 37 incorrectly suggests E_N need not be monotone. Writing R_N=P_(N+1)^(-2), the exact decrement is E_N−E_(N+1)=A x_(N+1)(R_N−1)≥0, now stated and proved. In the repaired claim the diagonal Stein relation gives the partial-trace lower bound s_M+Σ_(n<M)x_n s_n; summing initial diagonals is exactly seed energy by nonnegative summation. Strong stability of W* gives the tight defect construction, even for infinite trace. At finite equality the β-ratios are at most one and their limits with summable q_k give lim s_n=A and s_n=A where x_n>0. At zero-deficit indices the sequence cannot decrease before the next pinned value or the limit A, so all s_n=A; positivity then forces S=AI. Rank and the positive-product Riesz orbit establish the cardinality assertions. The repaired booster has diagonal A up to N and A/P_k² thereafter, and the exact energy formula and limit remain unchanged. Frozen checker.py is only a finite exact diagnostic; the proof and decrement calculation are the replay path, without executing the supplied script.

value.rationale: The result separates two useful design budgets: one seed may suffice while every energy-minimizing family needs infinitely many, and norm-one shifts may still rule out all finite acquisition families. The sharp energy and explicit near-minimizers quantify that distinction, including boundary examples. The corrected monotonicity supplies an exact improvement guarantee as the truncated defect family is enlarged.
